The live configuration matches it (TABLE_NAME=missing-table, LastModified 23:17:33Z), so the bad value was deployed from the template. In the window, every PutItem fails with AccessDeniedException on table/missing-table, because CrudApiRole only grants dynamodb:PutItem/GetItem/Query on the CartTable ARN.
